description: This file defines functions and types related to handling 'abort cutoff' logic in a messaging system, including resolving, reading, applying, and checking abort cutoff conditions based on message IDs and timestamps.

methods.name: resolveAbortCutoffFromContext
methods.description: Resolves an AbortCutoff object from a message context, extracting message ID and timestamp if available.

methods.name: readAbortCutoffFromSessionEntry
methods.description: Reads an AbortCutoff object from a session entry, extracting message ID and timestamp.

methods.name: hasAbortCutoff
methods.description: Checks if a session entry has an abort cutoff set.

methods.name: applyAbortCutoffToSessionEntry
methods.description: Applies an AbortCutoff object to a session entry, updating its message ID and timestamp.

methods.name: toNumericMessageSid
methods.description: Converts a string message ID to a numeric BigInt if valid.

methods.name: shouldSkipMessageByAbortCutoff
methods.description: Determines if a message should be skipped based on abort cutoff message ID or timestamp.

methods.name: shouldPersistAbortCutoff
methods.description: Decides whether to persist abort cutoff data based on session keys.
